title: Merchandise Purchases Gift Card Service Cap Table — Finch Circle Qualifying Spend
content:
**Cap rule.** On a gift card claim for a Merchandise Purchases unit, a member whose Finch Circle qualifying spend posted in the twelve calendar months before the request date (purchase earn entries whose posting date falls less than twelve whole months before it) reaches the upper gift card spend threshold of $1200.00 has the upper gift card service cap of $10.00; one whose such spend reaches the middle gift card spend threshold of $500.00 but not the upper has the middle gift card service cap of $5.00. A customer whose such spend is below $500.00 is outside this rule.

The spend is the qualifying amount of the purchase earn entries in the member's Finch Circle Loyalty Program points ledger.

| Qualifying spend, past twelve months (hypothetical) | Gift card service cap |
|---|---|
| $1200.00 | $10.00 |
| $1199.99 | $5.00 |
| $500.00 | $5.00 |
| $499.99 | outside this rule |
